name: Mad Packs | 3.5g Pre-Packaged Flower | MIA Runtz
description:
Sweet, fruity, and perfectly balanced — Mia Runtz is a hybrid known for its vibrant flavor and smooth, feel-good effects. Notes of ripe berries, subtle cherry, and a hint of citrus come together for a rich, flavorful smoke.

Mia Runtz delivers a happy, uplifting head high that gently settles into relaxing body effects, creating a balanced experience that’s great for unwinding without feeling too heavy.
